lines.en: On four limbs, I move fast.
Body forward, head almost to the ground.

lines.zh: 花瓣一样的脸一张一合
lines.en: My petal face opens and closes.
My claws land silently.
I pass between dead trees.
The hide on my back is drawn tight.
The dead grass closes behind me.
My joints bend the wrong way.
I circle the same stand of trees.
My shape warps between the branches.
I stop, head cocked.
I crouch in the blighted woods.
My face opens wide and draws closed.
Every tree here is dead.
I hear no birds.
I wait for a sound.
My skin shivers.
I have no eyes.

lines.zh: 空气里有铁锈和土的味道
lines.en: The air smells of rust and soil.
The fallen leaves crumble at a touch.
My limbs splay out like a spider's.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，但我知道你在哪
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I know where you are.
My face has opened.

lines.zh: 你身上有热乎乎的血味。
lines.en: You smell of warm blood.
You stand inside my range.
My head tilts.
I listen to your heartbeat.
You stepped back; I heard it.
Only you and I in this dead wood.
That knocked my face aside.
I press a hand to the wound.
There is little flesh under this hide.
Half a step back, then I return.
Pain makes me frantic.
My limbs shudder once.
The blood is dark.
I can still move.
That smell is too faint.
I do not want that.
Your hand shakes holding it.
Drop it.
The smell of blood is more real.
What you carry is not enough.
I come close, then withdraw.
I want only what is on you.

lines.zh: 我的身体很薄，像一层皮
lines.en: My body is thin, like hide.
I press in at once.
Our collision raises dust.
I press a hand to your chest.
We snap dead branches underfoot.
Being shoved irritates me.
You hit me from the side. Good.

lines.zh: 花瓣似的脸，贴到你后颈。
lines.en: My petal-like face presses against your neck.
I am alone in these woods.
I do not do such things.
I need only to feed.
My kind are not here.

lines.zh: 你问我为什么，我也不知道
lines.en: Ask me why and I could not say.
No other scent.
All season I have been searching.
Nothing blooms in the blighted forest.
I tear it open.
It is empty inside.
I drop it.
I sniff a long time before deciding.
Too small; not enough.
I take only what has blood.
I grind it into the mud.
These are useless to me.
I hear you.
Your breathing is too regular.
I am coming out of the woods.
The wind carries the smell.
I need not run; I can catch you.
You are still giving off warmth.
I have marked where you run.

lines.zh: 这片林子没有别的出口
lines.en: These woods have no other exit.

lines.zh: 我要的不是食物那么简单
lines.en: What I want is not simply food.
My face has opened again.

lines.zh: 你会听到我，但听不出方向
lines.en: You will hear me without knowing the way.
I can count your steps.
You have stopped.
That is best.

lines.zh: 我离你很近了，闻到汗味。
lines.en: I'm close now. I smell your sweat.
The time has come.
I have been following.
The way you are going is a dead end.
I am in the trees; you cannot see me.
The sound of dead branches is me.
You have circled three times.
My limbs grip firmly.
You are sweating.
I wait for you to stop on your own.
My shape is in every shadow.
There is a sound behind you.
You will not find a light.
When fire catches, I must back off.

lines.zh: 你听见花瓣张开的声音吗
lines.en: Do you hear my face opening?
The blighted woods are very quiet.
There is nowhere left to retreat.
I smell your blood.
My clawed hand lashes out.
That caught your shoulder.
My face comes right up to yours.
I drop from the treetop.

lines.zh: 爪子在护甲上擦出火花
lines.en: Claws scrape sparks off your armor.
You stagger back from the blow.
That was ugly and brutal.
I have your arm in my jaws.
My claws slipped off.
You hit me; I gave ground.
I press in again.
My limbs wrap around you.
Your blood falls to the ground.
I eat quickly.
You are still alive. Rare.
I drop low for the second strike.
Dead leaves crunch under me.
This one is the last.
I rise from behind the dead trees.

lines.zh: 花瓣一样的脸慢慢张开
lines.en: My petal face opens slowly.
Every tree here is grey.
Nothing living on the ground.
I heard a sound far off.
My skin cools in the wind.
I splay my limbs against the ground.

lines.zh: 枯林里出现了一个影子
lines.en: A shadow appears in the blighted wood.
First I tested the air.
I do not remember arriving.
This place is too bright.
I press my body down slowly.
Fire touches me and I recoil.
Water pours into my face.
The blast throws me into a dead tree.
Something passes through my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的四肢僵住
lines.en: That force freezes my limbs.
Too long starving; I cannot stand steady.

lines.zh: 雷打在枯林里，我看不见路
lines.en: Lightning strikes the dead wood; I lose the way.
No trees here, and no ground.
